# Load packages

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)

dir.create("Outdoors enzyme results", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Import data


```{r}
df <- read.csv("all_enzyme_data_outdoors.csv")
```

# Prepare variables

```{r}
df$Species <- as.factor(df$Species)

df$Treatment <- as.factor(df$Treatment)

df$`Plant.part` <- as.factor(df$`Plant.part`)

df$Enzyme.function <- as.factor(df$Enzyme.function)

df$Enzyme <- as.factor(df$Enzyme)
```

# Overall model

```{r}
model <- lmer(
  Log2.Fold.Change ~
    Enzyme.function *
    Treatment *
    Species *
    Plant.part +
    Experiment +
    (1 | Enzyme.function:Enzyme),
  data = df
)
```

# ANOVA

```{r}
anova_results <- anova(model)

anova_results
```

```{r}
write.csv(
    anova_results,
    "Outdoors enzyme results/ANOVA_Table.csv"
)
```

# Estimated marginal means

# Treatments

```{r}
emm_2 <- emmeans(model,  ~ Treatment | Enzyme.function * Species * Plant.part)

emm_pairs_2 <- pairs(emm_2, adjust = "BH")
emm_pairs_2

write.csv(emm_pairs_2,
          "Outdoors enzyme results/Treatments_Pairwise_Comparisons.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

```

# Diagnostics

```{r}
plot(model)
```


```{r}
qqnorm(residuals(model))
qqline(residuals(model))
```
